{"payload":"structural","carrier":"structural","limitations":["The retained 1.1.12 runtime records are legacy privacy projections. Schemas retain only fields whose native names and types survive that transform or are stated by official documentation; additional native fields may exist."]}

The legacy projection synthesized hasTextDelta, parameterKeys, and hasOutput. The model restores only the corresponding native field names/types proven by that transform; it does not treat the synthetic fields as vendor payload.
